claim: Bloodstream nanobots perform scouting and limited repairs.
originalWording: Bloodstream nanobots perform scouting and limited repairs.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Deployed in-body nanorobots scout the bloodstream and carry out limited repair, beyond passive drug nanoparticles.
reference.rationale: The verified adaptation puts this version in 2029, so it is pending. Medical microrobotics has genuine experimental progress but clinical translation and in-body autonomy remain material gaps.

evidence.title: Medical microrobots: clinical translation review
evidence.note: Clinical translation, safety and manufacturing challenges; nanoparticles are not autonomous bloodstream repair robots.. Clinical translation, safety and manufacturing challenges; nanoparticles are not autonomous bloodstream repair robots.
